description: Make a report of a project's test results, as the Reports page does: a verdict on readiness, the pass rate, the issues with their fixes, the agent's strengths and every test, saved as a snapshot that does not change afterwards. Report on chosen runs (by number), on the last few days, or on a date range (from_date, to_date). It builds in the background in about a minute and uses a language model for the strengths: read it with get_report until its status is ready. Returns the report's id and its link in the app.

days.description: Report on the runs of the last this many days. Without runs, days or from_date: the last 30 days.
days.title: Days

from_date.description: Report on the runs from this day (YYYY-MM-DD, from its start in UTC). Instead of days.
from_date.title: From Date

include_all_conversations.description: List every conversation, not only those with problems.
include_all_conversations.title: Include All Conversations

modes.description: Test modes to include; empty is all.
modes.title: Modes

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

runs.description: Run numbers to report on. Leave empty to report on a period instead.
runs.title: Runs

to_date.description: With from_date: the last day to include (YYYY-MM-DD, to its end in UTC). Without it: up to now.
to_date.title: To Date

name: create_report
